segments.sn46.30:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sumbhesu viharati setakaṃ nāma sumbhānaṃ nigamo.
segments.sn46.30:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā udāyī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā udāyī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn46.30:2.2: Yāva bahukatañca me, bhante, bhagavati pemañca gāravo ca hirī ca ottappañca.
segments.sn46.30:2.3: Ahañhi, bhante, pubbe agārikabhūto samāno abahukato ahosiṃ dhammena [dhamme (?)] abahukato saṅghena.
segments.sn46.30:2.4: So khvāhaṃ bhagavati pemañca gāravañca hiriñca ottappañca sampassamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
segments.sn46.30:2.6: ‘iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo;
segments.sn46.30:2.7: iti vedanā … pe … iti saññā … iti saṅkhārā … iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo’ti.
segments.sn46.30:3.1: “So khvāhaṃ, bhante, suññāgāragato imesaṃ pañcupādānakkhandhānaṃ ukkujjāvakujjaṃ samparivattento ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ,‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
segments.sn46.30:3.2: Dhammo ca me, bhante, abhisamito, maggo ca me paṭiladdho;
segments.sn46.30:3.3: yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathāhaṃ –
segments.sn46.30:3.4: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānissāmi.
segments.sn46.30:4.1: “Satisambojjhaṅgo me, bhante, paṭiladdho, yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathāhaṃ –
segments.sn46.30:4.2: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānissāmi … pe … upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo me, bhante, paṭiladdho, yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathāhaṃ –
segments.sn46.30:4.4: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānissāmi.
segments.sn46.30:4.5: Ayaṃ kho me, bhante, maggo paṭiladdho, yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathāhaṃ –
segments.sn46.30:4.6: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānissāmī”ti.
segments.sn46.30:5.2: Eso hi te, udāyi, maggo paṭiladdho, yo te bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathā tvaṃ –
segments.sn46.30:5.3: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānissasī”ti.

lines: Ukkujjāvakujjanti ettha ukkujjaṃ vuccati udayo, avakujjaṃ vayoti udayabbayavasena parivattento sammasantoti dīpeti.
Dhammo ca me, bhante, abhisamitoti vipassanādhammo abhisamāgato.
Sace hi thero tasmiṃ samaye sotāpanno, upari tiṇṇaṃ maggānaṃ atthāya, sace anāgāmī, arahattamaggassa atthāya ayaṃ vipassanā veditabbā.
Paccavekkhaṇatthāya upanīyatīti hi ettha adhippāyo, taṃ dassento evamāha.
Bahukataṃ vuccati bahukāro bahumāno, natthi etassa bahukatanti abahukato, akatabahumāno.
Dhammo uppajjamāno ukkujjanto viya nirujjhamāno avakujjanto viya hotīti vuttaṃ “ukkujjaṃ vuccati udayo, avakujjaṃ vayo”ti.
“Eso hi te udāyi maggo paṭiladdho, yo te … pe … tathattāya upanessatī”ti pariyosāne bhagavato vacanañcettha sādhakaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Tena tenākārena viharantanti yena sammasanākārena vipassanāvihārena viharantaṃ.
